messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-gpu-eu` (severity: high). Escalation policy: oncall-inference. Link: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD-12345
PagerDuty: Incident created -> PD-12345. Initial page to oncall-inference.
Maya S: acked. I'm on it, joining bridge in 30s.
Ravi K: @Maya S thanks — are we seeing customer 5xx or internal retries? any obvious metric spikes?
Maya S: quick snapshot: embedder 5xx rate spiked ~ 3.8% in eu region, request queue depth up x4. Saw a bunch of KV cache evictions at the same time.
Lena B: tagging product /support heads — customer-facing errors visible. Some PLG customers reported failed embeddings in last 5m.
ops-bot: autoscaler triggered: replica count for `embedder-eu` scaled from 4 -> 8 (policy: rapid-burst). Recent pod logs: `OOMKill` seen on embedder-2 -> restarting.
Maya S: joining bridge now. quick mitigation plan: (1) keep autoscaler at +4 temporarily, (2) roll node pool to replace nodes with high memory pressure, (3) add KV cache short TTL to reduce memory churn.
Ravi K: on bridge as well. If Maya needs to hand off, I can take over rotation.
Maya S: doing a controlled eviction of pods with high RSS. running command:
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=embedder-eu -o json | jq '.items[] | {name: .metadata.name, rss: .status.containerStatuses[].state}'
kubectl delete pod embedder-eu-2 --grace-period=30
```
Maya S: logs show repeated heap growth from tokenizer plugin after a specific prompt size. Suspect leak in tokenizer-lru.
ops-bot: metric snapshot: `requests_per_min` 420 -> 1200, `5xx_rate` eu 0.4% -> 3.9%, `queue_depth` 220 -> 860.
Lena B: customer impact estimate: approx 1.1% of active users in EU experienced failures in the last 10m. Raising priority to P1 customer comms if not mitigated in 20m.
Maya S: mitigation progress: queue depth down ~45% after scale + eviction. still seeing a handful of pod restarts. continuing to monitor.
Ravi K: if restarts continue, recommend temporary rollback to previous tokenizer container (tag: v1.4.2) and pin for the remainder of the day. Can do if you want me to take it.
Maya S: please stand by — I'll try one controlled rollback on a single pod and watch. If it helps, take ownership after that test.
Maya S: update (status ping): 3m after rollback test, target pod stable, 5xx rate trending down to 1.2%. queue depth normalizing.
Ravi K: happy to take baton now for the exclusive follow-up and customer sync. @Lena B can you kick off a brief summary for CS with current impact numbers?
Lena B: on it — drafting now. ETA 8m.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident PD-12345 acknowledged by Maya S, ownership transferred to Ravi K at request of original ack-holder.
Maya S: passing baton to @Ravi K — I'm adding notes to the incident doc with logs and the suspected tokenizer-lru memory leak.
Ravi K: I have it — will own post-mitigation follow-ups and remediation ticket. Next steps: backfill in jira INC-2026-547, schedule root cause dive with runtime team, and plan a canary of tokenizer rollback in staging.
Lena B: CS summary posted: https://confluence.example/incidents/PD-12345-summary. Customer comms queued for review.
Maya S: thanks all — leaving the thread. Good catch on the autoscaler working as intended. :thumbsup:
Ravi K: closing loop: 25m after first page, system stabilized, no ongoing 5xx spikes. I'll update the incident status to monitoring->resolved once CS approves the customer note.
incident-bot: Incident PD-12345 status: monitoring. Next update expected in 30m or upon resolution.
